note: How moves wear in (D55, D56, D59, D60). Every value here is a design draft by Claude, not research. Riya tunes them in the headset. hesitate_s = pause before it commits (seconds). wobble_deg = small head tremor. speed = playback speed. size = how big. smooth = 0 stiff, 1 eased. lean_deg, tilt_deg, flick_deg = head pitch lean, head roll tilt, antenna flick at the end.
